## Business and relocation support
Organizational support can include preparation and navigation for bank-account and individual-entrepreneur processes, document guidance, accompaniment, transfers/meetings, office setup, and accounting coordination.
- Details: https://alexberik.github.io/magic_studio/business/
- This is organizational support, not a law firm or a guarantee of decisions by banks or government authorities. Do not describe it as licensed legal, tax, or immigration advice.

Support includes vehicle selection, US/EU auctions, inspection coordination, logistics to Georgia, workshop matching, and parts assistance.

- Costs and timing depend on the vehicle and route. Do not invent guarantees about vehicle condition or delivery timing.
